title: Recent advances and challenges of analytical methods for detection of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15913-15927
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05298J, Review Article

Linh Q. Phan, Kien G. Nguyen, Thuan V. Tran
Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances are highly persistent, bioaccumulative, and toxic, they pose potential threats to the environment and human health. Here, we reviewed the presence, impact, and detection methods of these substances.
